record.title: DfCM reachable lawful frontier
record.body: R77 frontier after merge 8ecb78504241aef4fb1de1bd4f14bd1e71089a0b: (1) execute authenticated authority-scoped repository census and populate exact head for every reachable repository; (2) reconcile connector-reachable 100-repo surface with larger public repository universe without claiming inaccessible private completeness; (3) classify each RepositorySnapshot ExistingStructure→DesiredStructure→public Ontology→Pack/Composition→Generator; (4) qualify structural displacement candidates and compute live D; (5) enumerate and qualify consumer families to compute live F; (6) ingest exact Schedule-Run trailers across reachable repos and compute rolling 1h/24h/same-cell T; (7) promote any generalizable consumer refinements upstream then regenerate/requalify to compute U; (8) populate OCEL density vector from live Project/GitHub events; (9) admit RevenueFROMCustomer and RevenueFORCustomer only from independent economic evidence; (10) extract repeated census→classify→pack-select→qualify sequence into a factory-for-factories once at least two independent consumers evidence the repetition. Weakest multiplier remains qualified cross-repository fanout after exact universe population. 1000X NOT_ADMITTED.
